automaticCard.effect: Counterspell. Tags: arch-source, automatic, wizard-spell, abjuration, disruption. Trigger when a creature begins casting a spell. Make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + twice the spell's rank, treating rank 0 as 0. Success negates the triggering spell after its costs are paid; failure lets it resolve. This is gained automatically at Wizard 2 and is never also selected from the Arch pool.
automaticCard.name: Counterspell
automaticCard.rangeAndTarget: One creature you perceive casting a spell within 60 feet

source.originalText: Counterspell: Disrupt an enemy's spellcasting, potentially negating their spell entirely.
